newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss Publicitas buys U.S. Globe Media.
newsitem.headline: Swiss Publicitas buys U.S. Globe Media.

text.p: Swiss print media advertising group Publicitas Holding AG said it had bought Los Angeles-based Globe Media Inc, roughly tripling its advertising volume in North America to $57 million.

Publicitas said Globe Media, a privately-held company with offices in seven other U.S. cities plus Mexico City, was a promotion and sales agent specialising in attracting national and international advertising for newspapers and periodicals.
It said Globe Media was an agent for publications including the San Francisco Chronicle, Dallas Morning News, the Globe and Mail, Travel & Leisure, Food & Wine, Euromoney, Golf and Sunset.
It said Globe Media had an advertising volume of about $40 million, compared to Publicitas' current $17 million in North America. No price for the deal was named.
"This acquisition significantly strengthens the position of Publicitas in North America," the statement said.
It said Globe Media would be integrated into an existing international network of Publicitas promotion and sales agencies, which has 40 compnaies in 23 countries.
